title: PWM Interface
text: 模拟来自硬件的脉宽调制 (PWM) 输出，输入 1 路、输出 6 路；按 {Generate on} 指定Generate；{PWM waveform period (s)} 指定 PWM 波形的周期 50e-6、{Output mode}、{Counter mode} 指定 Counter waveform、{Sampling mode}、{Dead time (s)} 指定 Dead band switching、{At position of period} 指定 Signal change at position、{At compare n} 指定 Signal change at comparator n、{At compare n direction count} 指定 Signal change at comparator n、{Phase offset in degree (0-360)} 指定 PWM waveform offset scalar、{Type}、{ADC start condition} 指定 Trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM、{Number of replicas} 指定 Generate replica event ports、{PWM interrupt condition} 指定 Trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM、{Interrupt latency (s)} 指定中断生成延迟，按实例取值。

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: SoC 消息数据 numeric vector

ports.name: ~PWM
ports.summary: 互补脉宽调制信号 scalar

ports.name: dCycle
ports.summary: 脉宽调制信号的模拟近似 scalar

ports.name: event
ports.summary: 每个 PWM 周期发出的事件 scalar

ports.name: event n
ports.summary: 每个 PWM 周期发出的复制事件 scalar

ports.name: interrupt
ports.summary: 每个 PWM 周期发出的中断事件 scalar

params.name: PWM waveform period (s)
params.values: PWM 波形的周期 50e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sampling mode
params.values: Sampling mode End of PWM period (default) | Mid or End of PWM period | Immediate (at compare matches)

params.name: Dead time (s)
params.values: Dead band switching delay 1e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: At position of period
params.values: Signal change at position in period High | Low | Change | NoChange

params.name: At compare n
params.values: Signal change at comparator n trigger High | Low | Change | NoChange

params.name: At compare n direction count
params.values: Signal change at comparator n trigger High | Low | Change | NoChange

params.name: Phase offset in degree (0-360)
params.values: PWM waveform offset scalar from 0 to 360

params.name: Type
params.values: Type of events to generate ADC start (default) | PWM interrupt | ADC start and PWM interrupt

params.name: ADC start condition
params.values: Trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM period (default) | Mid of PWM period | Mid or End of PWM period | Compare 1 up count | Compare 1 down count | Compare 2 up count | Compare 2 down count

params.name: Generate on
params.values: Generate event on multiple of PWM update 1st event (default) | n th event | 16th event

params.name: Number of replicas
params.values: Generate replica event ports 1 (default) | integer from 1 to 16

params.name: PWM interrupt condition
params.values: Trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM period (default) | Mid of PWM period | Mid or End of PWM period | Compare 1 up count | Compare 1 down count | Compare 2 up count | Compare 2 down count

params.name: Interrupt latency (s)
params.values: 中断生成延迟 0 (default) | positive number
